summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a note purchase agreement with an accredited investor, issuing $45 million aggregate principal amount of promissory notes (A-1 Note of $15.78M and Secured B Note of $30M) on April 17, 2026. The notes are convertible into Class A common shares at a formula based on Nasdaq minimum price, with a share reserve requirement. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No deal terms like price per share or premium are applicable; the filing is purely a capital-raising arrangement.
